# Final Deployment Recovery Plan

## Evidence first
Read `scripts/production/canonical-server-activate.sh`, current workflow, and recent workflow history. Determine which assumptions can fail before activation.

## Implementation
Prefer one small remote deployment helper under `scripts/production/` that owns phase logging, safe diagnostics, bounded fetch retry, exact-SHA validation, reset/clean, activation, and post-deploy verification. Rewrite `.github/workflows/main.yml` whole so SSH invokes that helper rather than embedding an opaque multi-command block.

## Verification
Run shell syntax, local non-destructive preflight/dry-run if supported, source-law checks, workflow structural checks, and the relevant production verifier scripts where safe. Re-read touched files.

## Release
Commit deployment hardening separately in the isolated release worktree, fetch remote main, require strict fast-forward, push exact SHA, observe GitHub Actions, and verify the live reconciliation canary plus public Apps/Games/Transcribe routes.
